findings.title: Israeli strike kills three in vehicle distributing aid in Gaza, witnesses say
findings.location: Tel al-Hawa, Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Food distribution to children/displaced persons potentially affected: a vehicle hit by an Israeli strike contained packaged food, prepared rice meals, and papers bearing the World Central Kitchen logo. Reuters eyewitness reported it was about to distribute food and drink to children. Three fatalities are the same strike already recorded, NOT three new deaths. WCK's role and any program-level interruption remain unconfirmed.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: The vehicle appeared to be carrying packaged foodstuffs, and papers inside carried the logo of World Central Kitchen
findings.source_type: Established international news agency; reporter observation and identified eyewitness, with Israeli military response

bounded_discovery_context.prior_overlap: Earlier WAFA casualty report and AFP caption carried by Al Jazeera already logged the same three fatalities and food-rations transport. bounded_discovery_context.israeli_military_response: Israeli military said its target was several militant operatives in the area, without providing details about the vehicle or why it was hit.
bounded_discovery_context.caveats: World Central Kitchen did not respond by Reuters publication time; branded documents do not establish that vehicle or victims worked for WCK. Exact incident time, identities, quantities of food lost and impact on distribution routes are not established. No independent proof of distribution organization ownership.
